changeSet.author: alexander.stanik@htw-berlin.de
changeSet.comment: Store every file of an issue once in issue_attachments (with the uploader's context) and let quotation requests, quotations and order placements reference them by id instead of keeping copies in a separate order_attachments table.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE issue_attachments ADD uploader_context TEXT;
ALTER TABLE quotation_requests ADD attachment_ids LIST<UUID>;
ALTER TABLE quotations ADD attachment_ids LIST<UUID>;
ALTER TABLE order_placements ADD attachment_ids LIST<UUID>;
